ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan - Backgrounds & Traits（中世日本 - 背景と特性）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Adapts pawn backgrounds and traits to ancient-to-medieval Japan.
Backgrounds: Rewrites 126 existing backgrounds, adds 12 (adulthood: shrine officiant; shrine ritual attendant (shrine miko for women); itinerant ritualist (traveling miko for women); itinerant woodturner; falconer; potter; coastal fisher; coastal salt maker. Childhood: hunter's child; traveling artisan's child; fishing village childhood; weaver's child.) Excludes 135 anachronistic backgrounds from new pawn generation and adjusts 23 existing starting-possession records.
Traits: Adds likes alcohol (+2 mood while intoxicated) and dislikes alcohol (−2 mood while intoxicated). Excludes Transhumanist, Body Purist and all Drug Desire degrees, including teetotaler, from ordinary pawn generation.
RimWorld 1.6 / 1.7. Harmony required; Medieval Overhaul optional. Mid-save installation is possible, but its behavior in existing saves has not been verified; removing the Mod from an ongoing save is not recommended.
背景：既存背景126件の名称・説明を改稿。成人期8件（社の神職、社の神楽役（女性は「社に仕える巫女」）、巡回する祭祀役（女性は「渡り巫女」）、木地師、鷹匠、焼き物師、沿岸の漁師、浜の塩焼き）、幼少期4件（狩人の家の子、渡り職人の子、漁村育ち、織屋の子）を追加。時代に合わない既存背景135件を新しいポーンの生成候補から除外し、既存背景23件の初期所持品を見直します。
特性：酒好き（酩酊中の心情+2）・酒嫌い（酩酊中の心情−2）を追加。義体化願望・義体化嫌悪・薬物嗜好系特性（禁酒主義者を含む）を通常のポーン生成から除外します。
RimWorld 1.6／1.7対応。Harmony必須、Medieval Overhaulは任意。途中導入は可能ですが、既存セーブでの動作は未検証です。途中削除は推奨しません。
